meta.note: Aug. 26 changes: Puka Nacua remained out of team drills Tuesday and has now missed roughly two weeks, though he continues side-field work with no reported setback; injury risk rises modestly but overall rank is held. Breece Hall remains on track for Week 1 despite continued sideline work. Malik Nabers' ACL recovery continues to trend strongly upward after shedding the non-contact jersey and progressing in team work. Ashton Jeanty is described as on the mend from a lower-ankle sprain; Week 1 remains uncertain and Mike Washington Jr. remains the contingency back. Overall Top-150 ranks remain controlled by the master rankings files; this daily payload does not override overall rank.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.notes: Psoas/groin soreness has kept him out of team drills for roughly two weeks. He continued side-field work Tuesday with no reported setback, but the delayed return to team practice raises short-term concern. Hold elite season-long valuation while monitoring his return to full practice.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.notes: Believed to have a lower ankle sprain rather than a high-ankle injury and described as on the mend. Week 1 remains uncertain, but current reporting does not indicate a long-term injury.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.notes: Groin injury remains a short-term concern, but Aaron Glenn has said Hall is on track for Week 1. Hall has been working on the sideline while the Jets take a cautious approach.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.notes: ACL rehab continues to trend strongly upward. Nabers shed the non-contact jersey, participated in team work and is increasingly expected to be available Week 1 barring a setback.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.notes: Still a breakout target, but Tyler Biadasz is out for the year and Keaton Mitchell is solidifying RB2 work.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.notes: Jacksonville backfield looks committee-like; Chris Rodriguez has a legitimate lead-role case.

players.name: George Kittle
players.notes: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab; Week 1 outlook improved.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.notes: Preseason usage points to a clear RB2 role behind Hampton; useful contingency upside, but not an early-round overall value.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.notes: Carolina plans to open with a Brooks/Chuba Hubbard committee if Hubbard is healthy. Brooks still has a path to earn the lead role, but immediate volume ceiling is lower.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.notes: Working back from a hamstring injury; Panthers have indicated a Week 1 committee with Jonathon Brooks if Hubbard is healthy.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.notes: Dealing with a lower-body injury that is not believed to be severe. Washington's backfield remains fluid while Rachaad White also works back from injury.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.notes: Resumed individual work while recovering from a lower-leg injury; could share early-season work with Jacory Croskey-Merritt once both are healthy.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.notes: Alvin Kamara is expected to miss 4-6 weeks with an MCL sprain, strengthening Etienne's early-season workload and touchdown outlook.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.notes: Healthy and positioned for increased early-season work behind Travis Etienne while Alvin Kamara recovers from an MCL sprain.

rbCore.name: Ashton Jeanty
rbCore.label: LOW-ANKLE / WEEK 1 WATCH
rbCore.note: Believed to have a lower ankle sprain rather than a high-ankle injury and described as on the mend. Week 1 remains uncertain, but the season-long workload case remains elite when healthy.

rbCore.name: Breece Hall
rbCore.label: WEEK 1 TRENDING POSITIVE
rbCore.note: Groin injury has kept Hall out of team work, but Aaron Glenn says he is on track for Week 1. Current discount is more attractive if practice participation progresses as expected.

rbCore.name: Omarion Hampton
rbCore.label: TARGET — DOWN A NOTCH
rbCore.note: Still a breakout target, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season and Keaton Mitchell is emerging as the clear RB2.

rbBackup.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rbBackup.label: WEEK 1 FEATURE-BACK UPSIDE
rbBackup.note: Jeanty is on the mend from a lower ankle sprain but could still miss Week 1. Washington remains the clear feature-back candidate if Jeanty sits.

rbBackup.name: Tyler Allgeier
rbBackup.label: IMMEDIATE EARLY-SEASON UPSIDE
rbBackup.note: Jeremiyah Love is out the rest of preseason with a high-ankle sprain. Allgeier is the favorite to lead if Love misses Week 1 or is eased back.

rbBackup.name: Keaton Mitchell
rbBackup.label: CLEAR RB2 / ROLE GROWTH
rbBackup.note: Preseason usage indicates Mitchell is solidifying the RB2 job. He remains a later-round contingency target rather than an early-round overall value.

rbBackup.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
rbBackup.label: JAGUARS ROLE CHALLENGER
rbBackup.note: Jacksonville appears headed toward a committee, and Rodriguez has a legitimate early-down/short-yardage case against Bhayshul Tuten.

rbBackup.name: Jonathon Brooks
rbBackup.label: COMMITTEE WITH TAKEOVER PATH
rbBackup.note: Panthers expect Brooks and Chuba Hubbard to share work initially if Hubbard is healthy. Brooks remains the higher-upside bet to seize the lead role.

rbBackup.name: Kendre Miller
rbBackup.label: KAMARA ABSENCE BOOST
rbBackup.note: Kamara is expected out 4-6 weeks. Miller can earn meaningful complementary touches behind Travis Etienne.

rbBackup.name: Rachaad White
rbBackup.label: WASHINGTON BACKFIELD WATCH
rbBackup.note: White has resumed individual work while Jacory Croskey-Merritt deals with a lower-body injury. Both health and role distribution remain unsettled.

wrCore.name: Puka Nacua
wrCore.label: ELITE / PRACTICE WATCH
wrCore.note: Still out of team drills Tuesday after roughly two weeks with psoas/groin soreness. Side-field work continues and no setback has been reported. Hold elite rank for now, but another prolonged absence would increase concern.

wrCore.name: Malik Nabers
wrCore.label: HEALTH TRENDING STRONGLY UP
wrCore.note: Shed the red non-contact jersey and progressed through team work. Week 1 availability is increasingly expected barring a setback; the injury discount is becoming more attractive.

wrCore.name: DeVonta Smith
wrCore.label: ROLE EXPANSION
wrCore.note: Returned to full practice and still has a clearer path to career-high volume after A.J. Brown's departure.

qbCore.name: Justin Herbert
qbCore.label: FORMAT VALUE / OL WATCH
qbCore.note: Five-point passing TDs still help, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season, reducing the offensive-line improvement case.

teCore.name: George Kittle
teCore.label: REHAB TRENDING UP
teCore.note: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab. Age still matters, but availability outlook improved materially.
